description: This file provides utility functions for managing storage paths in a VSCode extension, including retrieving and setting custom storage paths, creating directories for tasks, settings, cache, and vector stores, and prompting the user for a custom storage path.

methods.name: getStorageBasePath
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the base storage path, using a custom path if configured and accessible, otherwise defaults.

methods.name: getStorageBasePathSync
methods.description: Synchronously retrieves the base storage path, using a custom path if configured and accessible, otherwise defaults.

methods.name: getTaskDirectoryPath
methods.description: Creates and returns the directory path for a specific task.

methods.name: getSettingsDirectoryPath
methods.description: Creates and returns the directory path for settings.

methods.name: getCacheDirectoryPath
methods.description: Creates and returns the directory path for cache.

methods.name: getLancedbVectorStoreDirectoryPath
methods.description: Creates and returns the directory path for the local vector store.

methods.name: promptForCustomStoragePath
methods.description: Prompts the user to input a custom storage path and updates configuration accordingly.
